definition.summary: Special weapons that do not rely on physical destructive power, but impose a concept or law on the opponent to cause harm.

principle.summary: Conceptual Weapons attack an object's existence or attributes rather than flesh; the source gives an example of a definition made into weapon form that can cut immortality by imposing the concept of being cut.

examplesInSource.label: 黑键
examplesInSource.summary: Black Keys are listed as a Holy Church conceptual weapon example; remake Ciel's nun outfit can hide many Black Keys.

examplesInSource.label: 石化魔眼
examplesInSource.summary: Petrification Mystic Eyes are listed as a conceptual weapon example in the Church/conceptual-weapons source summary.

examplesInSource.label: Gae Bolg（穿刺死棘之枪）的因果逆转效果
examplesInSource.summary: The causality reversal effect of Gae Bolg is listed as an example; this packet does not expand Fate-specific details.

examplesInSource.label: 第七圣典
examplesInSource.summary: Ciel's Seventh Holy Scripture is a permitted conceptual weapon, described in original as an anti-reincarnation instrument with a giant pile-bunker firearm body, and in remake as capable of pile-driver, greatsword, firearm, and ballista forms.
